943 |   /**
   944 |   @notice Withdraw function. Allows users to unstake.
   945 |   @param amount Amount to withdraw.
   946 |   @param token Address of the token for which to withdraw.
   947 |   */
   948 |   function withdraw(address token, uint256 amount) external {
   949 |     ILongShort(longShort).updateSystemState(marketIndexOfToken[token]);
   950 | 
   951 |     uint32 marketIndex = marketIndexOfToken[token];
   952 | 
   953 |     _withdraw(marketIndex, token, amount);
   954 | 
   955 |     if (userNextPrice_stakedSyntheticTokenShiftIndex[marketIndex][msg.sender] > 0) {
   956 |       // If they still have outstanding shifts after minting float, then check
   957 |       // that they don't withdraw more than their shifts allow.
   958 |       uint256 amountToShiftForThisToken = syntheticTokens[marketIndex][true] == token
   959 |         ? userNextPrice_amountStakedSyntheticToken_toShiftAwayFrom_long[marketIndex][msg.sender]

847 |   @param amount Amount to stake.
   848 |   @param user Address to stake for.
   849 |   */
   850 |   function _stake(
   851 |     address token,
   852 |     uint256 amount,
   853 |     address user
   854 |   ) internal virtual {
   855 |     uint32 marketIndex = marketIndexOfToken[token];
   856 | 
   857 |     // If they already have staked and have rewards due, mint these.
   858 |     if (
   859 |       userIndexOfLastClaimedReward[marketIndex][user] != 0 &&
   860 |       userIndexOfLastClaimedReward[marketIndex][user] < latestRewardIndex[marketIndex]
   861 |     ) {
   862 |       _mintAccumulatedFloat(marketIndex, user);
   863 |     }
